1339-4616-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4616-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

323-720-1806-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-720-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

710-1052-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-1477-3375-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-3375-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

206-252-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
206-252-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2511-3197-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1409-3099-4068-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1409-3099-4068-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5957-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1020-2866-5231-7692.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Repeat.

1368-1563-6321-7175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-7175.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4390-5078-6757-7633-7650.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6757-7633-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-4478.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2043-5231-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six multicolored permanents.
2043-5231-6741.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Robots, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

1978-3053-7290.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-7290.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Does Machines.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-2059-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

394-1445-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-4871-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

851-2043-2713-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1323-4687-5457.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

997-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1580-2018-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

348-1580-2178-5631.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
348-1580-2178-5631.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton and any other creature.
When Reassembling Skeleton and the other creature die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability from step 1, causing any number of players to lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature, and you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

413-618-2732.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 9, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

844-951-2232-2972-5184.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
When Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Shivan Devastator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {1}{R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Shivan Devastator for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

1154-2144-3729.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
1154-2144-3729.description:
Kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
Myrkul triggers, creating a token copy of Ondu Spiritdancer that is an enchantment.
When the token Ondu Spiridancer enters the battlefield, it and Grim Guardian trigger.
Resolve the Grim Guardian trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ondu Spiritdancer trigger, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 3.

967-2257-4166-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Reckless Fireweaver triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-3996-4050.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1912-3996-4050.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {W}.
When the Spirit dies, Twilight Drover triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

238-3604-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
238-3604-4050.description:
Cast Gerrard either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gerrard enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Gerrard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
The token Gerrard dies, returning the nontoken Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Gerrard triggers, exiling it if it's in your graveyard and returning all artifacts and creatures that were put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.

803-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
803-3670-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

539-3340-3459.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
539-3340-3459.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

413-1020-1492-4986.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
